all_main_citations.classification_basis: main.bbl output plus bibliography entry type; cited-form labels only

r5_applicability.definition: Matrix applicability; 20 minus NA. In R5 the 9 NA rows are fixed/non-learning scopes where a matched adaptive attack test is not the scoped claim.

narrow_sensitivity_excluding_hadad.rationale: If R5 is limited to experiments with a learned/calibrated adaptive attacker, the inspected fixed analytic padding proposal can be regarded NA rather than NR-R.

strict_deployment_task_utility.rule: Treat TDXRay as NA because its measured utility is vocabulary coverage in a lookup microbenchmark, not downstream task utility; other 19 status judgements retained.

arithmetic_note: R5 expanded values are 2 Bound + 2 Partial + 1 NR-R + 6 NR-V + 9 NA = 20. The NR-R cell is present as 0 (1) in six-check-audit.tex; no missing cell.
publication_note: Bibliography labels only. “venue-labelled” means main.bbl renders a journal/proceedings venue; “arXiv-only” means the bibliography entry gives arXiv without a journal/proceedings label. Neither label is an independent peer-review verification. Unknowns are retained.
